title: Rav Huna son of Rav Ika
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Pesachim 52b Rav Safra left the Land of Israel for abroad; Rav Huna son of Rav Ika and Rav Kahana accompanied him, from which Hyman infers that he was Rabbi Abbahu’s student. In Berakhot 43b Rav Papa visited him; Rav Papa took and blessed over myrtle; he said to him, “Does the Master not hold,” etc. In Beitzah 15a he raises an objection to Abaye’s words.
